lines.2: A blissful sanctuary where I wanted no one to disturb me.
lines.4: I heard something, but I still wanted to sleep, so I ignored it--
lines.6: The towel blanket was yanked away in one swift motion.
lines.9: 「Up, up! You're going to be late!」
lines.10: 「W-why are you... all the way here... this early?」
lines.11: 「I told you I'd take even better care of you from now on.」
lines.12: Wait, this... counted as taking care of me?
lines.13: 「Now that's a truly maidenly way to wake him. Well done, Konoe.」
lines.14: 「Just as I thought. I can entrust Leo to you.」
lines.16: 「Now, get up or I'll pinch your cheek!」
lines.17: 「Ngh... You're... back to your usual self, Konoe...」
lines.18: 「Maybe I liked the meek, cute version better...」
lines.20: 「Let me sleep a little longer and I'll kiss you...」
lines.22: 「Th-that's a little unfair, isn't it? If you say that, then I...」
lines.25: 「You took advantage of my weakness! Now get up already.」
lines.26: 「...Haha. It is wonderful to see you two getting along.」
lines.27: 「But as his big sister... I have rather mixed feelings.」
lines.28: 「Konoe first thing in the morning is rough when I've just woken up... Your voice goes right through my head.」
lines.30: 「One moment I think I can depend on you, and the next you're like this. Honestly, what am I going to do with you?」
lines.31: 「...Still, I like that side of you too.」
lines.35: 「So I'll keep taking care of you forever!」
lines.36: Wait... Had she just casually proposed to me!?
lines.38: She kept tugging hard at me.
lines.39: ...If she was already like this first thing in the morning,
lines.40: School was bound to be noisy too.
lines.41: 「A-all right. I'm up, I'm up. I can't win against you.」
lines.43: 「A woman needs guts and charm, after all!」
lines.44: My days with Konoe had only just begun--
